description: Direct tower geometry and travel contracts for framework, flat ironing, and gap-wall skip points.

mutants.description: Inverting the framework gate makes the disabled control copy the first-layer depth and makes the enabled run retain varying purge-depth geometry.
Removing framework first-layer depth propagation leaves later direct layers at their varying planned depths.
Disabling the unique constructor gate removes flat-ironing travel from the enabled direct-generator case while retaining ordinary gap-wall line ironing.
Dropping the skip-points condition incorrectly enables gap walls for rectangle and rib controls when skip points are disabled; the cone negative control remains false.
